python3 - <<'PY'
p='analysis/projects-export-2026-10-28/architecture.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('File handles remain ephemeral host IO and are structured-cloned only to a same-origin, parent-bound worker iframe. Each job gets a fresh realm, the existing compositor/audio pipeline writes directly to its selected handle, and completion is acknowledged after the file commits.','File handles remain ephemeral host IO. Each direct job receives a disposable EditorCore instance bound to its own canonical runtime and frozen snapshot. Autosave is stopped before loading; the visible editor singleton and source ownership are untouched. The existing compositor/audio pipeline writes directly to the selected handle, and completion is acknowledged after the file commits. The disposable instance releases managers, canonical state and media when finished.')
s=s[:s.index('\nDirect worker startup')]+ '\nDirect work starts through a lazy module import in the library page. Jobs are explicitly claimed and run sequentially, sharing canonical progress, cancellation and attempt fencing with the Render Queue. Native file handles are never serialized into project or queue state.\n'
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
